title: Frustrating Learning Curve
text:
As a new user, I am very taken with the power and functionality of Photomyne. The scanning process is the easy part. Understanding the nuances of the basic app and it’s companions has been a nightmare. There is so little documentation it is hardly worth calling it such. No user guide; very limited FAQs; no intuitive feel to the workflow; and no telephone support. The only way to get answers to unique questions is via email. That usually means a 24 hour time lag, at the minimum. I have spent hours scanning photos and at least as many hours trying to figure out next steps in the process.
if only Photomyne had invested as much resource to the creation of documentation as they have in hyping accessories, I would give them five stars.
I’m committed to the product and will continue to use it, but I may become a real thorn in the side of technical support before becoming competent.

title: Does not recognize all faces
text: I cannot get this app to recognize all faces in a photo. It also enhances only the face portion of a person. The enhancement feature automatically scans the photo and identifies the faces. But it doesn’t work 100% of the time. I cannot find a manual override ability to identify the missed face. Therefore, not something worth keeping. It’s not ready for prime time.

title: Cancelled my subscription and they still keep charging my card
text: Canceled my subscription and they keep charging my card and tell me I have to subscribe again and pay again and they refuse to cancel my subscription on there and and get rid of my card details.

title: Does an adequate job
text: I purchased photo mine when it was on sale to try and scan old family photos. I found it very difficult to capture the photos without glare without purchasing a lot of other accessories. The enhanced focus on the face is nice, but it does not enhance the focus on the remainder of the photograph. This results in many of the older photos looking like they have floating heads that are not in sync with the other objects in the photo. I have discovered Google photo scan seems to do a much better job at eliminating the glare.

title: Do not purchase!
text: Do not waste your $ on this app. I had used it years ago and was pleased. Purchased it again a few days ago to make a Christmas gift and was disappointed. After taking a bunch of photos, I looked at the results, poor resolution and reflections on the photos. Packed photos up and stopped using this app, it was a complete waste of my time. Called Apple for refund, was told to allow 24-48 hours for full refund. Got notification through email today that the refund has been denied by the company. This app isn’t cheap, I’m out over $63 and got nothing out of it. I’m going to use a scanner on my computer to make copies of photographs to keep the clarity, so I don’t lose resolution when I enlarge and print the photos. I’m so upset, I don’t have $ to waste like this. I wish I had read the reviews, prior to my purchase, instead of going by my past experience with this app. Reviews found for this app —> Image quality: The quality is not as high as a traditional scanner, and the resulting images may have less clarity and detail, especially when enlarged. *Also located this information: PhotoScan by Google is free and is the best app I've found. It takes 4 pictures of the photo and combines them to eliminated distortion and glare.*

title: Unfortunate Trap
